method.advance: Across at least two editor families with useful original masks, retain at least 75% of the useful locations, lose at most one useful source per family, and reduce control flags by at least 20% per source bank with control flags. Require at least four native useful locations and at least four native ordinary flags overall for a positive transfer. Scope is editing evidence only.
method.condition: Compare the original native app mask with the deployed exact horizontal flip and same original component retained at half aligned-grid overlap. Follow the runtime: repeat only if the original pass supplied at least one component. Keep the original source coordinates.
method.delivery: Upright 768 px long side and at least 512 px short side, lossless PNG. TGIF/TGIF2 uses sharp, feathered, untouched, local blur and local tone. Each BG-REAL source has the publisher edit, untouched file and matched whole-image autoencoder round trip.
method.sources: Use the next four geometry-eligible held TGIF/TGIF2 photos per family after the six used in the progressive JPEG comparison. Use all eight fixed slots in each of the two retained BG-REAL insertion banks. These photos were exposed in earlier work.
method.useful: At least .30 IoU and .50 edited-pixel recall. False highlights include ordinary processing controls.
